item.text: The queue was sorting priority names alphabetically, so `"normal"` preceded `"urgent"`. The separate batch sort only promoted Beacon shipments, masking the queue bug for that account. I’m removing that account special case so the batch follows the configured service ranks for every account.

The ordering now uses `SERVICE_RANK` inside the queue, and the dispatcher returns that order without a Beacon-only reorder. I’ll review the diff and working tree; I’m leaving tests untouched per the session instruction not to add or run them unless requested.
